svg.title: How the harness hands its tool calls to tau-cubed-bench
svg.desc: One turn of the tau-cubed-bench adapter. The model node runs, either on a new user message with graph.invoke(messages) or on resume with graph.invoke(None). If the graph is not paused before the tools node, the adapter returns the text reply. If it is paused, the adapter returns the pending tool calls, tau-cubed-bench runs them in its own environment and records them for its replay score, and the adapter writes the results into the checkpoint with update_state(as_node='tools') before resuming. The harness executes no tool.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The τ³ adapter: return tool calls, resume with results

svg.text: The same compiled graph, paused before its tools node on every tool call.
